A '''Podracing course''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], located in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. [[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor]], a [[Sneevel/Legends|Sneevel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], was considered to be the crowd favorite. It was the first race of the [[Professional Podracing Circuit]].
